ex: I'm busy at the moment. Can I call you back?
exTr: Şu anda meşgulüm. Seni sonra arayabilir miyim?
exAr: أنا مشغول في الوقت الحالي. هل يمكنني معاودة الاتصال بك؟

ex: I need to leave right now.
I'll send you the file right away.
So far, everything is going well.
exTr: Şimdiye kadar her şey yolunda gidiyor.
exAr: حتى الآن، كل شيء يسير على ما يرام.

ex: These days, everyone has a smartphone.
exTr: Bu günlerde herkesin akıllı telefonu var.
exAr: في هذه الأيام، الجميع يملك هاتفًا ذكيًا.

ex: At first I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
exTr: İlk başta şehri sevmedim ama şimdi bayılıyorum.
exAr: في البداية لم تعجبني المدينة، لكنني الآن أحبها.

ex: In the end, we decided to stay at home.
exAr: في النهاية، قررنا البقاء في البيت.

ex: At last, the holidays are here!

d: at the planned time; not late
ex: The train arrived on time.
We got to the cinema just in time for the film.
exAr: وصلنا إلى السينما في الوقت المناسب للفيلم.

ex: I still see my old teacher from time to time.
exTr: Eski öğretmenimi hâlâ zaman zaman görüyorum.
exAr: ما زلت أرى معلمي القديم من حين لآخر.

ex: It's nice to eat out once in a while.
exAr: من الجميل أن نأكل خارجًا بين الحين والآخر.

ex: Every now and then I go for a run.
All of a sudden, the lights went out.

d: at some time in the future, certainly
ex: Sooner or later, you'll have to tell him.
exTr: Er ya da geç ona söylemek zorunda kalacaksın.
exAr: عاجلًا أم آجلًا، سيتعين عليك إخباره.

ex: Let's sit here for a while.
I haven't seen you for ages!

d: in the time between two events
ex: Dinner is at eight. In the meantime, have a snack.
exTr: Akşam yemeği sekizde. O zamana kadar bir şeyler atıştır.
exAr: العشاء في الثامنة. في هذه الأثناء، تناول وجبة خفيفة.

ex: I'm living with my parents for the time being.
exAr: أعيش مع والديّ في الوقت الراهن.

d: over a long period of time
ex: Exercise saves money in the long run.
exAr: الرياضة توفر المال على المدى الطويل.

ex: We plan to move in the near future.
I met your brother the other day.
The exam is the day after tomorrow.
I called her the day before yesterday.
Sorry, I can't talk. I'm in a hurry.
exAr: آسف، لا أستطيع الكلام. أنا على عجلة.

ex: Can you buy bread on the way home?
exTr: Eve gelirken yolda ekmek alabilir misin?
exAr: هل يمكنك شراء الخبز في طريقك إلى البيت؟

ex: Move your bag; it's in the way.
By the time we arrived, the party was over.
exAr: بحلول وصولنا، كانت الحفلة قد انتهت.

ex: Come here at once!
Book your tickets in advance.

d: immediately, at the place where something happens
ex: They offered me the job on the spot.
Keep your phone up to date.
This map is out of date.
It rained on and off all day.
exTr: Bütün gün aralıklı olarak yağmur yağdı.

ex: The shop is open day and night.
He played the same song over and over again.
I've told you again and again: close the door!
exAr: قلت لك مرة بعد مرة: أغلق الباب!

ex: The guests left one by one.
Little by little, my English is getting better.
The video explains it step by step.
Make yourself at home. Are you staying at home tonight?
It's ten minutes on foot.
exAr: إنها عشر دقائق سيرًا على الأقدام.

ex: We went to the coast by car.
The bank is next to the post office.
I'll wait in front of the cinema.
The toilets are on the left.

d: in every part of the world
ex: People all over the world watch football.
exTr: Dünyanın her yerinde insanlar futbol izler.
exAr: الناس في جميع أنحاء العالم يشاهدون كرة القدم.

d: a long distance from; not at all
ex: The hotel is far from the centre.
We live close to the sea.
The lift is out of order, so take the stairs.
Sorry, that size is out of stock.
exAr: آسف، هذا المقاس نفد من المخزون.

d: available to buy; at a lower price
ex: Tickets go on sale on Monday.
Is this house for sale?

d: away from work or school for a rest
ex: We're going on holiday next week.
She's in Berlin on business.
exAr: هي في برلين في رحلة عمل.

ex: I can't talk now; I'm at work.
exAr: لا أستطيع الكلام الآن، أنا في العمل.

d: not working (because of illness or a holiday)
ex: He's been off work for a week with flu.
exAr: هو في إجازة من العمل منذ أسبوع بسبب الإنفلونزا.

d: working at a particular time (police, doctors)
ex: Which doctor is on duty tonight?
He doesn't like speaking in public.

d: yourself, not by phone or email
ex: I'd like to thank you in person.
I know the poem by heart.
Sorry, I didn't do it on purpose.
exAr: آسف، لم أفعل ذلك عن قصد.

ex: I found the old photos by accident.
We met by chance at the airport.
I took your umbrella by mistake.
They've left the country for good.
I'll be there for sure.
Children can enter the museum for free.
In a way, I'm glad it ended.
exAr: بطريقة ما، أنا سعيد لأنه انتهى.

ex: In any case, I'll call you tomorrow.
exAr: على أي حال، سأتصل بك غدًا.

d: in any way (in questions and negatives)
ex: I didn't sleep at all last night.
The repair will take two hours at most.
exTr: Tamir en fazla iki saat sürer.

ex: The work is more or less finished.
We arrived at the same time.
She's on the phone with a customer.
Did you see the fire on the news?

d: at the centre of; busy doing
ex: I'm in the middle of dinner. Can I call you later?
exTr: Yemeğin ortasındayım. Seni sonra arayabilir miyim?
exAr: أنا في منتصف العشاء. هل أتصل بك لاحقًا؟

ex: At the beginning of the year, I joined a gym.
exAr: في بداية العام، اشتركت في نادٍ رياضي.

ex: I'll finish the report by the end of the week.
I'll be ready in a minute.
The guests will arrive any minute now.
The baby cried all day long.
The library closes early on weekdays.
exAr: تغلق المكتبة مبكرًا في أيام الأسبوع.

ex: What are you doing at the weekend?
exAr: ماذا ستفعل في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع؟

ex: I always drink coffee in the morning.

d: all the time; for the full period
ex: It rained the whole time we were there.
exTr: Orada olduğumuz süre boyunca hep yağmur yağdı.
exAr: أمطرت طوال الوقت الذي كنا فيه هناك.
